'''Vurks''' were the predominant [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sembla/Legends|Sembla]]. They were tall, amphibious [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with bulbous dark [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and sweeping head crests. Their hands and feet had three digits each, one of which was opposable. They had distinguishing gray-green, leathery skin.

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:ColemanTrebor-TLC.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Jedi Master Coleman Trebor]]
The Vurk were [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibians]]. They were tall, with [[Color/Legends|gray-green]] skin and crested heads. Their hands had two fingers and an opposable thumb.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Society and culture==
Young Vurk males were married off by their parents; those who failed to marry before reaching adulthood remained bachelors for the rest of their lives.

==Vurk in the galaxy==
The Vurk [[Coleman Trebor/Legends|Coleman Trebor]] defied the cultural norm and went on to become a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member who fought and died during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]] after being shot by bounty hunter [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Another Vurk, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sweitt Concorkill/Legends|Sweitt Concorkill]], accompanied [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to a performance of [[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]] at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Vurk's protruding head crest is similar in appearance to the head crest of the hadrosaurid [[Wikipedia:Parasaurolophus|''Parasaurolophus'']].

[[Wikipedia:MAD Magazine|''MAD Magazine'']] satirically referred to the Vurk as "shoehorns".
